cue: a gate's child printed em dashes or Persian on a Windows console
lesson: read subprocess output through common.run_utf8 (encoding='utf-8'); text=True alone inherits the code page and the parent dies looking like a gate that said nothing

cue: frontmatter has a bare key followed by '- item' block lines
lesson: coerce None and a prior scalar into a list before appending -- parse_frontmatter is shared by every gate and a crashing gate is a silent gate

cue: rules/zones.json named a zone nobody had created and no code read agent_edit_never
lesson: validate the fence before trusting it: zone_check.check_zones_config judges rules/zones.json itself and promote refuses to run while it is broken

cue: an agent wanted to change a note a human wrote
lesson: agents create in 00_Inbox and never edit human zones; write a proposal and let the human merge -- action: edit into agent_edit_never is refused even when approved

cue: a verdict cited a probe that ran before the last edit
lesson: a fresh measurement matches the current state fingerprint AND the candidate digest; paperwork (14_CANDIDATES, 12_RUNTIME, the proposal sink) stays outside the fingerprint so filing never invalidates an honest run

cue: evidence pointed at a path starting with a dot, like .kb/kb.sqlite
lesson: strip a leading './' as a prefix, never with lstrip('./'): the character class eats the dot and the gate reports a real file as a fabrication
source: found by the loop's own row

cue: the loop named a change nobody had run
lesson: verdict: proposed is legal on the shelf and never promotable; count the shelf as proposed == adopt + revise + drop + keep_base + open so no row disappears quietly

cue: a gate returned 1 and printed nothing
lesson: every refusal names the row and the reason, and returns from inside the branch that found the problem -- a silent gate gets switched off because nobody can tell it from a clean one

cue: a cycle found nothing better than the current state
lesson: write keep_base instead of inventing a change; measuring and deciding to change nothing needs no run and is a legitimate result

cue: a generated instruction file names a path that no longer exists
lesson: every host door is generated from AGENTS.md, so a stale path in the canon is republished to five agents at once; lint the backticked paths in the body and refuse the render, do not review the prose by eye
source: porting claude-obsidian agent-at-work behaviour to every host

cue: a validator counts a README as if it were a note
lesson: documentation is not a note: one shared prose predicate in common.py keeps link and frontmatter gates in agreement, while a per-gate exclude list drifts the moment either gate changes
source: issue 8: an installed brain must be green with no app

cue: generated record bodies turn the vault gates red
lesson: whatever a script writes into the vault must satisfy the vault schema itself: a generated OVERVIEW.md without frontmatter made the frontmatter gate fail on files no human ever opened

cue: a bad value was accepted at write time and only rejected by the later check
lesson: validation belongs at the door: --add refuses an unknown verdict or a confidence outside 0..1 before the row exists, because a refusal that arrives after the write becomes a cleanup task instead of a gate
source: issue 7: the repo keeps its own lessons

cue: a document quotes a test count that no longer matches the suite
lesson: a number typed into a document rots silently and gets repeated as fact; the measured block between two markers is written by a script and staleness itself is a failing health gate, so CI reads the number instead of trusting the prose
source: issues 4 and 10: stale README badge and seeded status block

cue: AI-looking Persian text passes review and still contains an Arabic letter
lesson: an Arabic ta marbuta (U+0629) leaked into generated Persian prose again and only the byte-level hygiene gate saw it: scan the bytes of every generated Persian line, never the rendered glyphs, and treat a hygiene warning as a red gate
source: this session: qc caught the lookalike in a freshly written paragraph

cue: every gate is green on my machine and CI is red on a fresh clone
lesson: a gate run on the writing machine proves only that the writing machine is consistent: local-only state (.kb/, 12_RUNTIME/, 13_LAB/, gitignored caches) exists there and nowhere else, so reproduce CI first by copying exactly what git ls-files reports into an empty folder and running the gate there, and refuse any evidence path that lives behind the documented boundary
source: this session: CI red on 4 matrices while health printed 6 OK lines

cue: someone proposes falling back to the last known good state
lesson: last known good is only real if the bytes are on disk and a fingerprint proves those bytes are the state the record describes: measure the base by running the gates before saving it, keep the folder holding the snapshots outside the identity they record (paperwork), and refuse a journal entry whose bytes are gone rather than reporting a successful recovery
source: this session: the last piece of the chosen harness2 spine
